description:
Change a counter screen

Changes only the fields you send: name, place, voice agent, face, interface languages (comma separated, e.g. `de,en`), idle text, opening line, on or off, the conversation limits and the opening hours in a time zone.

body.description: The request fields as one JSON object.

avatarProfileId.description: `id` of one of your faces from `GET /presence/avatars`, `null` for voice only.

name: update_presence_device
title: Change a counter screen
